$comment: Coverage of the core library and the template app, and the template's golden-set eval score. Both run on the deterministic fake model, so they need no key.

gates.name: coverage
gates.cmd: node tools/py.mjs -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider core/tests template/backend/tests --cov=ai_app_chassis --cov=app --cov-report=term --cov-report=json:.harness/quality/coverage.json
